lockedExperienceIdea: The site behaves like an intimate service ritual at the pâtisserie counter: arrival, attention, choice, preparation, handoff and return create the experience rhythm.
lockedPrinciples: Human service sequence is the governing experience behavior.
Users should receive immediate contextual response rather than theatrical delay.
Practical product, visit, route and shop information remains part of the ritual rather than breaking out into generic utility UI.
Mobile is treated as direct personal service, not a stacked-down desktop experience.
Motion and interaction should communicate attention, response, preparation or handoff rather than generic premium animation.

selectionRationale: Counter Ritual is selected for deeper exploration because its service behavior can govern navigation, interaction, motion, mobile UX and conversion while remaining more project-specific than a purely editorial or documentary visual grammar.
